verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials describe a finance team issuing instant virtual cards for each software subscription with per-vendor spending limits (ramp-docs-31). Its agent-card docs separately point to reusable Virtual Cards and merchant-scoped spend restrictions (ramp-supp-agent-cards, ramp-supp-agents-site). A hands-on user reports spinning up a new business expense card in under a minute (ramp-comm-2). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of purpose- or category-scoped cards such as ad spend (only per-vendor scoping is shown), and in-depth first-party documentation of virtual card creation controls beyond marketing summaries.
